activation_disposition.reason: An independent project implementation and six-test synthetic fixture are frozen, but no fitted outer-fold state or eligible dataset activation receipt exists.
activation_disposition.selection: All five remain mandatory perturbation comparators when their assay and target interface is applicable. Inapplicability must be reported; no deep model receives credit for beating a silently malformed baseline.

shared_assay_native_contract.biological_unit: experimental replicate, independent liver-chip batch, or animal as declared by the DatasetManifest
shared_assay_native_contract.pseudobulk_order: Aggregate raw counts within target locus, declared context, and biological unit before any normalization, feature selection, centering, fit, or metric. Collapse technical lanes and guides under a frozen target-family rule.
shared_assay_native_contract.fit_weighting: Each biological unit has total weight one; target rows inside a biological unit share that weight. Cells, guides, targets, libraries, and genes never add biological replication.
shared_assay_native_contract.response: Y[r,t,c,g] is the biological-unit pseudobulk expression profile on one DatasetActivationContract-frozen assay-native scale. Raw counts, normalized expression, fold change, differential-expression statistics, and cross-species ortholog summaries are distinct outputs and are never pooled as if commensurate.
shared_assay_native_contract.delta: D[r,t,c,g] = Y[r,t,c,g] - M_control[r,c,g], where M_control is a matched within-biological-unit control profile. If that match is absent, D is structurally_missing unless a hierarchy was frozen before outcomes were read.
shared_assay_native_contract.gene_axis: Freeze gene IDs, order, duplicate handling, ortholog rule where relevant, masks, and transform before fit. A missing gene or failed crosswalk is not zero expression.
shared_assay_native_contract.strata: Any source, species, assay, cell state, time, dose, intervention class, and control hierarchy used for matching is predeclared and fit inside the outer-training partition. Outcome-selected nearest matching is prohibited.

control_mean.formula: mu_control[c,g] = sum_r w_r Y_control[r,c,g] / sum_r w_r over eligible outer-training biological units; predict absolute profile mu_control and perturbation delta exactly zero.
control_mean.fitting: Fit the control centroid independently inside every outer-training partition and declared stratum. Biological-unit weights are equal after within-unit target aggregation.
control_mean.task_role: mandatory baseline; may win an applicable exploratory endpoint, but no current perturbation task can produce a sealed champion

perturbed_mean.formula: mu_pert[c,g] = sum_(r,t) w_(r,t) Y_pert[r,t,c,g] / sum_(r,t) w_(r,t) over eligible outer-training units and targets; predict absolute profile mu_pert and delta mu_pert - mu_control.
perturbed_mean.fitting: Exclude every held target locus, guide family, biological unit, and outer-development source. Give each biological unit total weight one and divide that weight across its eligible targets.
perturbed_mean.unseen_target_behavior: Use the same training perturbed centroid without inspecting target outcomes. This is a population prior, not target-specific prediction.
perturbed_mean.task_role: mandatory baseline and the Systema matching-mean equivalent for the currently registered single-component held-target task

ridge_perturbation.feature_vector: x[r,t] = [1, c[r], z[t]], where c is a pre-outcome context vector and z is an outcome-independent held-target-capable feature vector. Target IDs, nearest-gene substitutions, outcome-derived embeddings, and tokens unavailable for held noncoding loci are forbidden.
ridge_perturbation.formula: B_hat(lambda) = argmin_B sum_(r,t) w_(r,t) ||D[r,t] - x[r,t] B||_2^2 + lambda ||P B||_F^2; P leaves the intercept unpenalized.
ridge_perturbation.selection: Select lambda by inner target-locus, guide-family, and biological-unit grouped cross-validation on gene-macro squared error; choose the largest lambda within one standard error of the minimum. All centering and scaling is inner-training-only.
ridge_perturbation.fail_closed: If a target feature manifest that is computable for every held target is absent, or an inner grouped split is infeasible, this baseline is not runnable. It does not silently become target-ID regression, nearest-gene regression, or context mean.

bilinear_perturbation.feature_vector: phi[r,t] = [1, c[r], z[t], vec(c[r] outer_product z[t])]. This is bilinear in context and target inputs and linear in fitted parameters.
bilinear_perturbation.formula: Theta_hat(lambda) = argmin_Theta sum_(r,t) w_(r,t) ||D[r,t] - phi[r,t] Theta||_2^2 + lambda ||P Theta||_F^2; P leaves the intercept unpenalized.
bilinear_perturbation.selection: Use the same grouped inner folds, endpoint, one-standard-error rule, biological-unit weights, and training-only transforms as ridge_perturbation.
bilinear_perturbation.resource_rule: The full feature dimensions and memory estimate must be frozen before a campaign. Outcome-driven rank reduction is prohibited; if the exact Kronecker design exceeds the approved resource ceiling, report unschedulable rather than changing the model after seeing results.
bilinear_perturbation.fail_closed: The context and target vectors must both be computable for held targets and contexts without outcome access. Otherwise this baseline is not runnable.

systema.published_matching_mean: For a two-component perturbation X+Y, predict 0.5 * (m[X] + m[Y]). A component observed as a singleton in outer training uses its equal-biological-unit mean; an unseen component uses mu_pert. For the registered single-component held-target task, matching mean is defined to equal perturbed_mean.
systema.project_unit_adaptation: The publication defines cell-level means. This benchmark first creates biological-unit pseudobulk and then takes equal-biological-unit means so cells do not become replicates; this adaptation must be labeled in reports.
systema.strict_systema_reference: Let v_train be the outer-training perturbed centroid. The evaluator may report R_v(y) = y - v_train for both observed and predicted profiles. This is a fixed linear translation, not a fitted perturbation model and not confounding, batch, guide, or leakage correction.
systema.evaluation_outcome_reference: Any diagnostic that instead derives v from evaluation outcomes is transductive and evaluator-only. It cannot enter fitting, calibration, model selection, prediction repair, or a champion claim.
systema.duplicate_win_rule: On the current single-component task, systema and perturbed_mean form one baseline family and cannot count as two independent wins, two hypotheses, or complementarity evidence.
systema.task_role: mandatory published comparison after independent implementation; no upstream source code reuse

split_and_leakage_contract.target_holdout: All guides, sequence windows, cells, and derived outcomes for one target locus remain in one role.
split_and_leakage_contract.fit_scope: Centroids, feature rosters, transformations, covariate encoding, scaling, regularization, component matching, calibration, and any ortholog mapping are fit or frozen inside outer training.
pseudoreplication_prohibitions: Cells do not define folds, confidence intervals, or n.
Guides and targets do not define biological replication.
The 33 GSE313774 libraries do not replace its three independent batches.
Approximately 103000 GSE275483 cells do not replace its four animals.
Seeds are stability repeats, not biological replicates.
split_and_leakage_contract.held_outcome_firewall: No held expression, differential-expression statistic, target centroid, guide effect, pathway score, or highlighted gene can construct a baseline, scale, feature, match, or reference.

missingness_contract.rule: Carry assay, gene, control-match, target-feature, ortholog, and join masks through every fit and PredictionBundle. Missing entries never become measured zero or zero response.
missingness_contract.model_behavior: A baseline that cannot produce the full registered output axis emits a typed missing state for the affected rows and is excluded only under the evaluator's precommitted completeness rule.

calibration_uncertainty_and_selection.calibration: These five methods natively emit continuous expression profiles, not probabilities. No post hoc probability calibration or Brier claim is defined. Any future binary endpoint needs a separately registered cross-fitted calibrator.
calibration_uncertainty_and_selection.uncertainty: Use 10000 paired experimental-replicate, independent-batch, or animal cluster-bootstrap replicates as specified by the TaskSpec. Resample target rows only inside their sampled biological unit; never resample cells or guides as independent units.
calibration_uncertainty_and_selection.seeds: Ridge and bilinear fitting is deterministic for a frozen design and solver. Any solver or tie randomness must use the RunSpec seed and be recorded; seed variation is not inferential uncertainty.
calibration_uncertainty_and_selection.champion: The current task is exploratory and has no sealed source. A simple baseline may be the endpoint winner, but no MASLD perturbation champion can be declared.

runtime_safe_loading_terms_and_release.implementation: An independent project implementation exists at src/masld_bench/perturbation_baselines.py. No fitted state exists. It uses bounded validated arrays and does not deserialize untrusted objects.
runtime_safe_loading_terms_and_release.runtime: The six-test deterministic CPU fixture passed on SLURM job 21066694. This establishes formula, weighting, missing-match, held-target, and strict-reference behavior on synthetic inputs only; it is not a dataset activation or performance result.
runtime_safe_loading_terms_and_release.systema_terms: The exact official repository revision has no detected license in the current registry audit. Do not copy, import, vendor, or redistribute its code. Independently implement only the published equation.
runtime_safe_loading_terms_and_release.release: Source code release requires a project-license decision. Fitted summaries and predictions remain subject to every dataset's source terms and source-reference-only or aggregate-only policy.

safe_loading_contract.project_fitted_state: Store centroids, masks, ordered feature manifests, scalers, coefficients, regularization choice, and split receipts in bounded non-executable formats.

source_evidence: The official Systema paper and exact official repository revision were inspected without copying upstream code. An independent five-baseline implementation and six synthetic unit tests passed on CPU SLURM job 21066694 on 2026-08-24. No fitted fold state or admissible dataset activation exists.
